description: This PHP class defines a scheduled task within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the Crunz Event class and manages execution of console commands, handling errors and logging.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a scheduled console task in OrangeHRM, capable of executing commands and handling errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Task with command info, console context, and output interface.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the associated console command, returns exit code, logs errors if exceptions occur.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command information associated with this task.
